initial.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Produce ONE production sprite atlas for a layered 2D chibi paper-doll game, on genuine transparent RGBA background. Image 1 is the approved DeepSeek STYLE reference: match its polished rounded 2-head-tall proportions, large shiny eyes, clean dark outlines and soft cel shading. Image 2 is CHARACTER IDENTITY only: preserve that character's hair, eyes, costume and accessories, simplify ornament for a 108-pixel-tall game sprite. Do NOT copy DeepSeek's whale/maid identity onto the new character. Strict layout: square atlas, exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 16 isolated cutouts, each centered in its own cell with generous transparent gutters, no crossing cell boundaries. No labels, text, grid lines, ground shadows, backgrounds or watermark. Row 1: four identical-size front-view HEADS (head, short framing hair, ears, ornaments ONLY, no shoulders or long rear hair), in neutral smile, happy open-mouth, surprised O-mouth, sleepy closed-eyes expressions. Keep head outline and accessories registered identically. Row 2: (1) complete clothed torso and short flared skirt, with neck but NO head/arms/legs, concealed shoulders fully painted; (2) screen-left relaxed full arm with matching sleeve and hand, shoulder root at upper-right; (3) screen-right relaxed full arm with matching sleeve and hand, shoulder root at upper-left; (4) screen-left short leg with stocking and shoe, upper thigh overlap included. Row 3: (1) screen-right short leg with stocking and shoe; (2) screen-left bent full arm holding a pencil pointing downward toward a desk; (3) screen-right bent full arm resting hand on desk; (4) screen-left bent full arm holding a small rice bowl near chest. Row 4: (1) screen-right bent full arm raising a spoon toward mouth; (2) FULL BODY seated resting chibi, knees bent, hands resting on lap, eyes closed, same outfit, actual seated pose, no cushion; (3) separate long rear hair mass with full hidden center painted, no face/body; (4) separate character-specific tail or rear ornament specified below. All arms include fully painted sleeve roots with overlap. Keep front-facing orientation and lighting consistent. Cutouts are anatomical illustrated game parts, not schematic shapes. Render at the highest useful square resolution.
CHARACTER: Copper orange long hair, amber eyes, orange daisy and black ribbon on screen-right, ivory high-neck scholarly dress with black waist and burnt-orange front panel, simplified daisy embroidery, cream lace-up boots. No held book in neutral hands. Last cell: separate dangling orange-and-black ribbon tassel.

kimiBowl: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE isolated bent arm sprite on genuine transparent background, matching Kimi in this reference atlas. It is the character's screen-left arm, white sleeve with navy star capelet, shoulder root at UPPER LEFT, forearm bends inward to the right, ONE small hand supporting a small white rice bowl at the right near chest height. Exactly one arm and one hand, no extra hand and no spoon, no body, no head, no lettering. Fully paint sleeve root for overlap, complete outer outline with 10% transparent margin, same chibi soft shading and line weight as reference. The arm's shoulder will attach on the LEFT side of the game character.
claudeAndGeminiRepair: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair this game sprite atlas. Keep the exact illustrated identity, colors, shapes and 16 cutouts in exactly the same reading order. Re-layout all sixteen cutouts onto a strict 4 by 4 square grid. EACH cutout must have at least 10 percent of its cell width of TRANSPARENT padding on every side, including the outer canvas edge. Scale each cutout down to fit its cell; no head hair may touch adjacent heads or the edge. Make row boundaries exactly at 25%,50%,75%. Keep true alpha transparency, no colored speckles or shadows. Row 2 column 1 must be ONLY headless armless torso and skirt; remove both sleeves and hands from that cutout and repaint complete torso beneath. Row 3 column 4 must be ONLY ONE bent screen-left arm with sleeve and ONE hand supporting rice bowl; REMOVE any second hand/arm. All other anatomy/costume/expressions preserved. No labels or grid lines. High-quality same soft chibi shading.
rejectedRearHair: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game atlas of SIX isolated REAR HAIR cutouts matching the six chibi characters in this reference contact sheet, same reading order. Wide 3 columns by 2 rows layout, one rear hair mass per cell, at least 50 pixels of true transparency margin between each item and canvas edges. NO heads, faces, bodies, ears, crowns, hats, ribbons, wings, hands, accessories, ornaments, or text. Each cutout must be just the long hair from crown to tips, seen from the front behind the head, FULLY FILLED center painted so it can be occluded by separate head and body sprites. Top row: Claude long copper wavy hair; Gemini blue-violet long hair with lavender tips; GPT long white hair with pale lavender shading. Bottom row: Grok long golden twin-tail hair mass filled behind the head; Kimi silver-white long wavy hair; Qwen periwinkle long hair. Maintain the approved soft polished chibi anime shading and thick clean outlines. No props. No extraneous fragments. Genuine transparent background.

Use case: background-extraction. Remove the entire colored gradient/glow background from this six-hair atlas. Keep ONLY the six illustrated hair masses, preserving their original colors, linework, exact shapes and positions. Do not change hair shading or recolor white hair. Production game sprite cutouts.
rejection: Both replacement rear-hair atlases retained opaque gradients; excluded from runtime. Original native rear-hair crops narrowed to avoid neighboring parts.
